## deck.info [#deck.info]

**Deck info.** Title, theme, sections with slide ids and titles, counts (the canvas slides, charts and guides included) and the current revision.

It takes no input.

- Command line: `turboslide info`
- MCP tool: `deck_get_info`
- HTTP: `POST /api/actions/deck.info`
- Runs on: command line, MCP, HTTP, page.
- Changes the presentation: no.

## deck.create [#deck.create]

**New deck.** Creates a deck under decks/ from a template of the index (template.list), the deployment default when `from` is absent (Blank: one title slide in the Simple theme, light), and returns its id, revision and counts.

| Field  | Type   | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| ------ | ------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `name` | string | yes      | The deck title; the id is its slug unless `id` is given                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `from` | string | no       | A template id of the index (template.list): 'blank' writes one title slide in the Simple theme; 'gt-brand' copies the General Translation brand deck (95 slides, 8 sections, the assets); a saved template copies its folder. The deployment default (template.list `default`) when absent |
| `id`   | string | no       | The deck id under decks/; derived from the name when absent                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |

- Command line: `turboslide deck create <name> --from <from> --id <id>`
- MCP tool: `deck_create`
- HTTP: `POST /api/actions/deck.create`
- Runs on: command line, MCP, HTTP, page.
- Changes the presentation: yes.

## deck.set [#deck.set]

**Set a deck field.** Writes one field of the deck manifest by JSON pointer (/title, /theme, /defaults/appearance, /defaults/counter, /defaults/notes) as one deck.set mutation, the write the Theme panel and Slide numbers make; an absent value removes the field. /theme takes an id of theme.list (gt-ink-paper is stored as general-translation).

| Field          | Type    | Required | Description                                                                                                |
| -------------- | ------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `path`         | string  | yes      | JSON pointer into the manifest: /title, /theme, /defaults/appearance, /defaults/counter or /defaults/notes |
| `value`        | unknown | no       | The new value; omit it to remove the field                                                                 |
| `baseRevision` | integer | yes      | The revision the caller read; a stale value is rejected with 409                                           |

- Command line: `turboslide deck set <path> <value>`
- MCP tool: `deck_set`
- HTTP: `POST /api/actions/deck.set`
- Runs on: command line, MCP, HTTP, page.
- Changes the presentation: yes; send the `baseRevision` you read.

## deck.pack [#deck.pack]

**Pack deck bundle.** Writes decks/\<id\> (deck.json, slides, assets, versions and the sidecars) as one zip with a manifest.json carrying the bundle version, the deck id, its revision and a digest per file (docs/deck-transfer.md).

| Field      | Type    | Required | Description                                                           |
| ---------- | ------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`       | string  | yes      | The deck id under decks/                                              |
| `out`      | string  | no       | The zip to write; defaults to \<id\>-r\<revision\>.zip                |
| `versions` | boolean | no       | Carry versions/\<n\>.json; on by default (--no-versions turns it off) |

- Command line: `turboslide deck pack <id> --out <out>`
- MCP tool: No MCP tool.
- HTTP: No HTTP endpoint.
- Runs on: command line.
- Changes the presentation: no.

## deck.unpack [#deck.unpack]

**Unpack deck bundle.** Creates a deck under decks/ from a bundle zip after validating it, under a free id when the bundle id is taken unless `replace` removes the deck that holds it (docs/deck-transfer.md).

| Field     | Type    | Required | Description                                                                        |
| --------- | ------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `file`    | string  | yes      | The bundle zip to read                                                             |
| `as`      | string  | no       | The deck id to write under; the bundle id when absent                              |
| `replace` | boolean | no       | Remove the deck that holds the id first; without it a taken id gets a free sibling |

- Command line: `turboslide deck unpack <file> --as <as> --replace`
- MCP tool: No MCP tool.
- HTTP: No HTTP endpoint.
- Runs on: command line.
- Changes the presentation: yes.

## deck.push [#deck.push]

**Push deck to a studio.** Packs decks/\<id\> and uploads the bundle to a hosted studio through POST /api/decks/bundle with the bearer token, so the deck can be edited there (docs/deck-transfer.md).

| Field     | Type    | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                        |
| --------- | ------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`      | string  | yes      | The deck id under decks/                                                                                                                                                           |
| `to`      | string  | yes      | The studio, such as https://turboslide.vercel.app                                                                                                                                  |
| `token`   | string  | no       | The bearer token (TURBOSLIDE_TOKEN of the deployment); kept in ~/.config/turboslide/hosts.json after the first use                                                                 |
| `as`      | string  | no       | The id the deck takes on the studio; the local id when absent                                                                                                                      |
| `replace` | boolean | no       | Replace the deck of that id on the studio                                                                                                                                          |
| `fromUrl` | string  | no       | A bundle already stored at a URL the studio may read (the deck store Blob host); the studio fetches it instead of receiving the bytes, for bundles over a function 4.5 MB body cap |

- Command line: `turboslide deck push <id> --to <to> --token <token> --as <as> --replace --from-url <fromUrl>`
- MCP tool: No MCP tool.
- HTTP: No HTTP endpoint.
- Runs on: command line.
- Changes the presentation: yes.

## deck.pull [#deck.pull]

**Pull deck from a studio.** Downloads a deck bundle from a hosted studio through GET /api/decks/\<id\>/bundle with the bearer token and unpacks it into decks/, so the deck can be edited locally (docs/deck-transfer.md).

| Field     | Type    | Required | Description                                                                                                        |
| --------- | ------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `id`      | string  | yes      | The deck id on the studio                                                                                          |
| `from`    | string  | yes      | The studio, such as https://turboslide.vercel.app                                                                  |
| `token`   | string  | no       | The bearer token (TURBOSLIDE_TOKEN of the deployment); kept in ~/.config/turboslide/hosts.json after the first use |
| `as`      | string  | no       | The id the deck takes under decks/; the id on the studio when absent                                               |
| `replace` | boolean | no       | Replace the local deck of that id                                                                                  |

- Command line: `turboslide deck pull <id> --from <from> --token <token> --as <as> --replace`
- MCP tool: No MCP tool.
- HTTP: No HTTP endpoint.
- Runs on: command line.
- Changes the presentation: yes.

## deck.copy [#deck.copy]

**Make a copy.** Copies a deck under a new id with a new title, every slide or the named ones, with or without the speaker notes, at revision 0 with an empty version log; the output names the new deck.

| Field          | Type     | Required | Description                                                                         |
| -------------- | -------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`           | string   | yes      | The deck to copy                                                                    |
| `name`         | string   | yes      | The title of the copy; its id is the slug unless `newId` is given                   |
| `newId`        | string   | no       | The id of the copy under decks/                                                     |
| `slideIds`     | string[] | no       | Copy these slides only, in deck order; every slide when absent                      |
| `removeNotes`  | boolean  | no       | Leave the speaker notes out of the copy                                             |
| `copyComments` | boolean  | no       | Carry the comment threads into the copy with their ids; off by default              |
| `baseRevision` | integer  | yes      | The revision of the source deck the caller read; a stale value is rejected with 409 |

- Command line: `turboslide deck copy <id> --name <name> --id <newId> --slides <slideIds> --remove-notes --copy-comments`
- MCP tool: `deck_copy`
- HTTP: `POST /api/actions/deck.copy`
- Runs on: command line, MCP, HTTP, page.
- Changes the presentation: yes; send the `baseRevision` you read.

| -------------- | ------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |

| `baseRevision` | integer | yes      | The revision the caller read; a stale value is rejected with 409 |

- Changes the presentation: yes; send the `baseRevision` you read.

| Field          | Type    | Required | Description                                                                  |
| -------------- | ------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `deckId`       | string  | yes      | The deck to save                                                             |
| `name`         | string  | yes      | The template name; its slug is the template id                               |

| `baseRevision` | integer | yes      | The revision of the deck the caller read; a stale value is rejected with 409 |

## deck.tailor [#deck.tailor]

| `baseRevision` | integer  | yes      | The revision the caller read; a stale value is rejected with 409                  |

## assist.propose [#assist.propose]

**Ask the assistant.** Asks the assistant for a proposal over the named slides: a shorter rewrite or speaker notes, or a free ask that resolves to one of the two; answers signed cards a caller accepts with assist.accept. A read: nothing is written until a card is accepted.

| Field          | Type                          | Required | Description                                                                                                            |
| -------------- | ----------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `intent`       | "shorter" \| "notes" \| "ask" | yes      | 'shorter' rewrites the slide’s text shorter, 'notes' writes speaker notes, 'ask' resolves the prompt to one of the two |
| `prompt`       | string                        | yes      | The seller’s ask, in their words; empty for a starter card                                                             |
| `slideIds`     | string[]                      | no       | The slides the ask is about; the deck’s first slides when absent                                                       |
| `baseRevision` | integer                       | yes      | The revision the caller read; a stale value is rejected with 409                                                       |

- Command line: `turboslide assist propose <prompt> --intent <intent> --slides <slideIds>`
- MCP tool: `deck_assist_propose`
- HTTP: `POST /api/actions/assist.propose`
- Runs on: command line, MCP, HTTP, page.
- Changes the presentation: no.
